title: Renewal Loyalty Credit on the Home-Site Lease — Training Cases
content:
**Training note: the renewal-loyalty credit**

On a twelve-month renewal of the Home-Site Lease, a renewal-loyalty credit counts the renewal elections the resident has signed and had accepted on the lease — the accepted renewal elections among the lease requests. The credit is a flat dollar amount per month, taken once from the monthly site rent written into the renewal.

**Rule.** At least 5 accepted renewal elections give 3.00 per month; at least 2 but fewer than 5 give 1.50 per month; fewer than 2 give none.

| Accepted renewal elections on the lease | Renewal-loyalty credit |
|---|---|
| 5 or more | 3.00 per month |
| 2, 3 or 4 | 1.50 per month |
| 0 or 1 | none |

### Cases

1. *Six accepted renewal elections on the lease* — 3.00 per month.
2. *Exactly five* — the threshold is met: 3.00 per month.
3. *Four* — 1.50 per month.
4. *Exactly two* — 1.50 per month.
5. *One* — none.
6. *A renewal election that was never accepted* — not counted; only accepted elections count.

*Hypothetical figure.* With three accepted renewal elections, 1.50 a month is taken once from the rent written into the renewal: 734.30 becomes 732.80.
